text: 1. foreigners, 18 years old or above, in good health 2. graduates of senior high school or above Qualification of being exempt from the first one or two years study: 1. Any holder of HSK 3 can apply to join the second year of the program. 2. Any holder of HSK 6 can apply to join the third year of the program. 3. Students who have achieved 80 credits of required courses verified by OEC are eligible to apply and, with the approval from OEC, join the third year of the program. 4. Students who have passed the third-grade entrance exam can apply to join the third year of the program and are required to pass HSK 6 before graduation. 5. Any holder of HSK 5 can apply to join the third year of the program and is required to pass HSK 6 before graduation.
